title: Faraday rotation in a gyroelectric slab (Born's model)
source: D. W. Berreman, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 62, 502-510 (1972), Eqs. 13 and 56-60
notes: Berreman gives the closed form, not numbers; the values here are chosen. eps = [[e, -i g, 0], [i g, e, 0], [0, 0, e]] (his Eq. 13 with gamma -> g). At normal incidence the circular waves see e + g and e - g (his Eqs. 57-60), so the eigenvalues of the transmission Jones matrix are the two circular Airy transmissions. The test checks that.
